'''Illodian Sibilant''' was a language, presumably used by the [[Illodian]]s. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] attempted to use Illodian Sibilant to communicate secretly with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Barth]] while in [[Yevetha]]n custody, but the latter did not speak the language.<ref name="TT">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>

==Known phrases==
*''Stach isch stralsi ?'' - Can you speak this language?<ref name="TT" />
*''Slatha essach sechel.'' - Keep it yourself.<ref name="TT" />

*''[[Tyrant's Test]]'' {{1st}}
